title: My account
description: Your profile, security settings and notification preferences.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Full name
profile.emailHint: The email address can't be changed. Ask your administrator for a new invitation to use another address.
profile.languageHint: Used for the interface and for emails sent to you.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password signs you out on your other devices.
password.hint: At least 10 characters; mix letters with digits or symbols.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: In addition to your password, sign-in asks for a code from the authenticator app on your phone.
mfa.step1: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
mfa.manual: If you can't scan, enter this key manually:
mfa.step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.
mfa.recoveryBody: If you lose access to your phone, sign in with one of these codes. Each works once, and they won't be shown again after you close this screen.
mfa.disableBody: Your account will be protected by your password only. Enter your password to continue.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Sign out everywhere, including this device. Use it if you lost a device or suspect your account.
sessions.confirmBody: You'll need to sign in again on this device too.

notifications.title: Notification preferences
notifications.description: Choose which events notify you in the app and by email.

issue_assigned.title: An issue was assigned to you

issue_resolved.title: An issue was resolved
issue_resolved.hint: Issues you reported or were assigned

maintenance_due.title: Maintenance is due
maintenance_due.hint: Plans due within 7 days or overdue
